# OpenAI image wire fixtures

Retrieved on 2026-08-05 from the first-party OpenAI API reference:

- Image generation: https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/images/methods/generate
- Image edits: https://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/images/methods/edit

The fixtures cover JSON generation, multipart edits, base64 output, URL output, and content-policy rejection. Prompts and image bytes are synthetic. API keys, Authorization headers, account identifiers, and real asset URLs are excluded.
